name: tracker-rehearsal-status
goal: Report configured Tracker fleet and spoke sync state through native status using signed disposable fixture evidence.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pinned Tracker status includes connected sync state, durable pending count and fleet runner rows, all missing from configured native status.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The worker lifecycle only exercised an unconfigured spoke. It now drives a journal push, pull and signed machine exchange via synthetic ports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Exact fd8412eebc on MB2: expected computers and connected sync, got empty computers and disabled sync.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Project actual link acknowledgements and signed fleet runner samples through the native supervisor.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Exact 9860910033 on MB2 with one worker passes the unchanged status and lifecycle assertions.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
